subject.title: Fix subagent announce restart recovery cascade

question: Should OpenClaw accept persisted announceLastRun plus non-running "killed" reconciliation as canonical recovery behavior for aborted subagent completion announce turns, with those turns always tool-free?
rationale: The patch is coherent, but it changes persisted session lifecycle behavior and the security-relevant internal tool boundary for inter-session announce delivery.

options.title: Accept and land
options.body: Keep the persisted marker, killed reconciliation, and tool-free announce invariant as the canonical fix for this cascade.

options.title: Adjust recovery state first
options.body: Change the reconciliation target or lifecycle naming before merge while preserving the announce-vs-human turn distinction.

options.title: Pause for broader delivery model
options.body: Hold this PR if maintainers want announce, lock, and delivery recovery solved through a wider session-delivery redesign first.

recommendation.title: Accept and land
recommendation.body: Keep the persisted marker, killed reconciliation, and tool-free announce invariant as the canonical fix for this cascade.

likelyOwner.reason: The sampled history ties this owner most directly to restart lifecycle, gateway lifecycle state, and Codex internal-turn/tool-surface paths.
